atomic_action_cases.name: allowed_named
atomic_action_cases.rationale: Named NextPage is one of the permitted action and name combinations.

atomic_action_cases.name: gotor_action_with_ef_file_spec
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A GoToR OpenAction's /F file specification contains /EF; veraPDF creates the same CosFileSpecification object and applies containsEF whether the file spec is reached through an action or the EmbeddedFiles name tree.

atomic_action_cases.name: submit_form_action_with_ef_file_spec
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A SubmitForm OpenAction's /F file specification contains /EF; confirmed to fire the same containsEF check as a GoToR action's file specification.

atomic_action_cases.name: gotor_action_without_ef_file_spec
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A GoToR action's file specification has no /EF entry, so containsEF passes for both validators.

atomic_action_cases.name: open_javascript
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A catalog OpenAction uses the forbidden JavaScript action type.

atomic_action_cases.name: open_missing_subtype
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A dictionary-valued OpenAction has no S name.

atomic_action_cases.name: open_indirect_subtype
atomic_action_cases.rationale: The action model resolves an indirect S name and rejects JavaScript.

atomic_action_cases.name: open_destination_array
atomic_action_cases.rationale: An array-valued OpenAction is a destination and does not instantiate PDAction.

atomic_action_cases.name: unreferenced_javascript
atomic_action_cases.rationale: An unreferenced action-looking dictionary is outside the action model.

atomic_action_cases.name: page_additional_action
atomic_action_cases.rationale: The O trigger in page AA reaches a JavaScript action.

atomic_action_cases.name: page_unknown_additional_action
atomic_action_cases.rationale: An unknown page AA key is not exposed as an action trigger.

atomic_action_cases.name: annotation_action
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A page annotation A entry reaches a JavaScript action.

atomic_action_cases.name: annotation_additional_action
atomic_action_cases.rationale: The E trigger in annotation AA reaches a JavaScript action.

atomic_action_cases.name: annotation_unknown_additional_action
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A form-field trigger name in ordinary annotation AA is not exposed.

atomic_action_cases.name: outline_action
atomic_action_cases.rationale: An outline item A entry reaches a JavaScript action.

atomic_action_cases.name: outline_stream_action
atomic_action_cases.rationale: Unlike most action sources, an outline A entry accepts a dictionary-based stream and exposes its JavaScript S name.

atomic_action_cases.name: outline_stream_node_action
atomic_action_cases.rationale: The outline traversal accepts a stream-backed outline node and reaches its JavaScript action.

atomic_action_cases.name: next_action
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A forbidden action is reached through a dictionary-valued Next entry.

atomic_action_cases.name: next_action_array
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A forbidden action is reached among dictionary entries in a Next array.

atomic_action_cases.name: next_stream_action_ignored
atomic_action_cases.rationale: PDAction.getNext accepts only COS dictionaries or arrays of COS dictionaries, so a stream-backed Next action is ignored.

atomic_action_cases.name: next_action_cycle
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A self-referential Next graph terminates and its single GoTo action satisfies the action-type predicate.

atomic_action_cases.name: named_forbidden
atomic_action_cases.rationale: Named is an allowed action type but Print is a forbidden named action.

atomic_action_cases.name: named_missing
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A Named action has no N value.

atomic_action_cases.name: named_wrong_type
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A string-valued N is exposed as null rather than as a named action.

atomic_action_cases.name: named_indirect_forbidden
atomic_action_cases.rationale: The named-action model resolves an indirect N name before rejecting Print.

atomic_action_cases.name: non_named_with_forbidden_n
atomic_action_cases.rationale: The named-action predicate is inapplicable to a URI action.

atomic_action_cases.name: widget_action_wrong_type
atomic_action_cases.rationale: Widget containsA is raw key presence even when A is not a dictionary.

atomic_action_cases.name: widget_a_null
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A Widget's direct null /A value is empty and passes containsA, matching the same direct-null convention confirmed for containsAA on the catalog.

atomic_action_cases.name: widget_indirect_subtype_action
atomic_action_cases.rationale: An indirect Widget Subtype still creates PDWidgetAnnot, whose A key is forbidden.

atomic_action_cases.name: stream_widget_action_ignored
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A stream-backed Widget in page Annots does not instantiate PDWidgetAnnot.

atomic_action_cases.name: widget_additional_actions
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A Widget contains an empty AA dictionary.

atomic_action_cases.name: widget_aa_null
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A Widget's direct null /AA value is empty and passes containsAA.

atomic_action_cases.name: widget_additional_javascript
atomic_action_cases.rationale: Widget AA is forbidden and its E trigger reaches JavaScript.

atomic_action_cases.name: text_additional_actions
atomic_action_cases.rationale: An AA key on a Text annotation is not a Widget violation.

atomic_action_cases.name: field_additional_actions
atomic_action_cases.rationale: An AcroForm field contains an empty AA dictionary.

atomic_action_cases.name: field_aa_null
atomic_action_cases.rationale: An AcroForm field's direct null /AA value is empty and passes containsAA.

atomic_action_cases.name: direct_field_additional_actions
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A direct (non-indirect) dictionary in AcroForm Fields still instantiates PDFormField.

atomic_action_cases.name: field_additional_javascript
atomic_action_cases.rationale: Field AA is forbidden and its K trigger reaches JavaScript.

atomic_action_cases.name: stream_acroform_field_additional_actions
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A stream-backed AcroForm is dictionary-based and its top-level field is modeled.

atomic_action_cases.name: stream_field_additional_actions
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A stream-backed dictionary in AcroForm Fields instantiates a top-level PDFormField.

atomic_action_cases.name: stream_field_aa_javascript
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A field accepts a dictionary-based stream for AA and reaches its K JavaScript action.

atomic_action_cases.name: child_field_additional_actions
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A named child in a form-field Kids array is itself a field.

atomic_action_cases.name: child_without_t
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A child dictionary without T is not instantiated as a PDFormField.

atomic_action_cases.name: stream_child_field_additional_actions
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A stream-backed child with T is dictionary-based and instantiates PDFormField.

atomic_action_cases.name: unnamed_child_reused_as_top_field
atomic_action_cases.rationale: An unnamed dictionary is skipped as a child but remains applicable when the same object is also listed directly in AcroForm Fields.

atomic_action_cases.name: top_field_without_t
atomic_action_cases.rationale: Every dictionary directly in AcroForm Fields instantiates a top-level field.

atomic_action_cases.name: unreferenced_field_additional_actions
atomic_action_cases.rationale: An unreferenced field-looking dictionary is outside the AcroForm model.

atomic_action_cases.name: combined_widget_field_actions
atomic_action_cases.rationale: One dictionary reached from both page Annots and AcroForm Fields instantiates both Widget and field predicates.

atomic_action_cases.name: catalog_additional_actions
atomic_action_cases.rationale: The document catalog contains an empty AA dictionary.

atomic_action_cases.name: catalog_aa_null
atomic_action_cases.rationale: Confirmed against veraPDF 1.30.2: a document catalog with a direct null /AA is compliant, matching the same direct-null convention as containsEmbeddedFiles/isOptionalContentPresent/containsEF. Fixed a real bug where Dictionary::has(b"AA") (and the equivalent widget /A, widget /AA, and field /AA presence checks) treated a literal null value as present.

atomic_action_cases.name: catalog_additional_javascript
atomic_action_cases.rationale: Catalog AA is forbidden and its WC trigger reaches JavaScript.

atomic_action_cases.name: catalog_unknown_additional_action
atomic_action_cases.rationale: Catalog AA key presence fails while an unknown trigger does not expose its value as an action.

atomic_action_cases.name: catalog_additional_actions_wrong_type
atomic_action_cases.rationale: Catalog containsAA is raw key presence even when AA is not a dictionary.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: subtype_file_attachment
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: FileAttachment is forbidden in PDF/A-1.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: subtype_missing
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A page annotation dictionary has no Subtype.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: subtype_indirect
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: The annotation model resolves an indirect Subtype name before applying the allowed-subtype predicate.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: stream_annotation_ignored
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A stream in page Annots is dictionary-based but is not a COS dictionary, so veraPDF does not instantiate PDAnnot.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: direct_invalid_annotation
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A direct dictionary in the page Annots array still instantiates PDAnnot.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: direct_page_invalid_annotation
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A Page dictionary embedded directly (not indirectly) in the page tree's Kids array is still walked; veraPDF validates its annotations exactly as it would an indirect page.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: unreferenced_invalid_annotation
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: An annotation-like object absent from page Annots is inapplicable.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: opacity_zero
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: Annotation opacity CA is zero rather than one.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: opacity_zero_indirect
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: An indirect numeric CA is resolved before the opacity predicate is evaluated.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: opacity_wrong_type
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A nonnumeric CA is exposed as null by the pinned annotation model.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: flags_missing
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: An annotation has no required flags.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: flags_invisible
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: The Invisible flag is set despite the Print flag.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: flags_invisible_indirect
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: An indirect integer F value is resolved before its annotation flag bits are tested.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: color_c_rgb
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: Annotation colour is permitted with an RGB PDF/A-1 output profile.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: color_c_cmyk
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: Annotation colour is used with a CMYK output profile.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: color_c_null
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: An annotation's direct null C value is empty and passes containsC, matching the same direct-null convention confirmed for containsAA, with a CMYK output profile so the check is not vacuously satisfied by gOutputCS == RGB.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: color_c_wrong_type
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A scalar C value is not exposed by PDAnnotation.getCOSC and therefore does not set containsC, even with a CMYK output profile.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: color_c_indirect_array
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: An indirect array-valued C is exposed as present and conflicts with a CMYK output profile.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: color_ic_without_output
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: Annotation interior colour is used without a PDF/A-1 output profile.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: no_color_cmyk
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A non-RGB output profile is harmless when C and IC are absent.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: appearance_n_stream
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A non-button annotation has an AP dictionary containing only a stream-valued N.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: appearance_n_dictionary
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A non-button annotation has a subdictionary-valued normal appearance.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: appearance_n_and_r
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: The appearance dictionary contains R in addition to N.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: appearance_empty
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A present but empty appearance dictionary does not contain only N.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: appearance_wrong_type
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A non-dictionary AP is exposed as null by the pinned annotation model.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: widget_button_dictionary
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A button Widget has a nonempty normal appearance subdictionary.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: widget_button_empty_dictionary
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A button Widget has an empty normal appearance subdictionary.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: widget_button_stream
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A button Widget uses a stream rather than an appearance subdictionary for N.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: widget_button_scalar_state
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A nonempty N subdictionary whose only state is scalar has no modeled appearance streams and fails containsAppearances.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: widget_text_stream
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A non-button Widget has a stream-valued normal appearance.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: widget_inherited_button_dictionary
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A Widget inherits FT Btn from its parent field and has an appearance subdictionary.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: widget_inherited_button_stream_parent
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: Widget FT inheritance walks dictionary-based parents, including a stream-backed parent field.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: icc_separation_alternate
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: A selected Separation models the ICCBased profile in its alternate colour space.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: icc_separation_valid
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: A selected Separation models and accepts a valid ICCBased alternate with matching N.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: icc_devicen_alternate
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: A selected DeviceN models the ICCBased profile in its alternate colour space.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: icc_devicen_valid
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: A selected DeviceN models and accepts a valid ICCBased alternate with matching N.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: icc_devicen_wrong_n
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: The ICCBased alternate of a selected DeviceN validates N against the embedded profile colour space.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: icc_page_group
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: A page transparency Group models its ICCBased CS independently of the adjacent transparency prohibition.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: icc_page_group_valid
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: A page Group accepts a valid ICCBased CS while independently failing the PDF/A-1 transparency prohibition.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: icc_page_group_wrong_type
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: A wrong-type Group CS creates no ICCInputProfile object; the Group remains independently forbidden.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: icc_page_group_inherited
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: A page Group resolves a named ICCBased CS through inherited page-tree resources.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: icc_form_group
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: An invoked Form transparency Group models its ICCBased CS independently of the adjacent transparency prohibition.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: icc_annotation_appearance
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: A colour space selected in a page annotation appearance stream models its ICC profile.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: icc_annotation_appearance_valid
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: A valid ICCBased selection in an annotation appearance satisfies both profile predicates.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: icc_annotation_state
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: Every normal Widget appearance state is traversed, including an invalid ICCBased state not selected by AS.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: icc_annotation_unreferenced
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: An appearance on an annotation outside every page Annots array remains inapplicable to ICCBased validation.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: icc_pattern_content
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: Painting a tiling Pattern traverses ICCBased selections in the Pattern content stream.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: icc_pattern_content_valid
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: A valid ICCBased selection in painted Pattern content satisfies both profile predicates.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: icc_pattern_unused
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: An unpainted Pattern resource and its invalid ICCBased content remain outside the modeled content graph.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: icc_pattern_without_selection
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: Probe: a Pattern resource name supplied to scn without first selecting a Pattern colour space is not painted by veraPDF.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: icc_pattern_underlying
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: veraPDF 1.30.2 deliberately does not expose the underlying ICCBased space of an uncoloured Pattern.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: device_page_group
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: A page transparency Group exposes its DeviceRGB CS against the CMYK output intent.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: device_form_group
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: An invoked Form transparency Group exposes its DeviceRGB CS against the CMYK output intent.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: device_annotation_appearance
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: DeviceRGB used in an annotation appearance conflicts with the CMYK output intent.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: device_annotation_unreferenced
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: DeviceRGB in an appearance on an unreferenced annotation remains outside the modeled colour graph.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: device_pattern_content
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: DeviceRGB used in painted Pattern content conflicts with the CMYK output intent.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: device_pattern_unused
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: DeviceRGB in an unpainted Pattern resource remains outside the modeled colour graph.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: device_image_default
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: DefaultRGB replaces DeviceRGB in an invoked image before device-colour validation.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: device_image_inherited_default
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: An inherited DefaultRGB replaces DeviceRGB in an invoked image.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: device_image_default_wrong_type
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: A wrong-type DefaultRGB suppresses the invoked image's DeviceRGB without creating another modeled colour space.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: device_inline_default
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: DefaultRGB replaces the RGB abbreviation in an inline image before device-colour validation.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: device_indexed_default
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: DefaultRGB replaces DeviceRGB in the base of a selected Indexed space.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: device_separation_default
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: DefaultRGB replaces DeviceRGB in the alternate of a selected Separation.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: device_devicen_default
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: DefaultRGB replaces DeviceRGB in the alternate of a selected DeviceN.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: device_output_invalid_rgb
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: The global output-colour fold observes RGB even when the matching PDF/A-1 profile has an invalid device class.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: device_output_truncated
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: A matching PDF/A-1 profile without a readable colour-space header sets the global output colour to null.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: device_output_rgb_then_cmyk
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: The last matching PDF/A-1 output profile wins the global fold, so a trailing CMYK profile conflicts with DeviceRGB.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: device_output_cmyk_then_rgb
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: The last matching PDF/A-1 output profile wins the global fold, so a trailing RGB profile satisfies DeviceRGB.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: device_output_pdfa_rgb_then_wrong_s_cmyk
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: A later profile whose S is not GTS_PDFA1 leaves the previously folded RGB output colour unchanged.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: device_cmyk_image_rgb_output
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: An invoked DeviceCMYK image conflicts with an RGB PDF/A-1 output profile.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: device_cmyk_image_default
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: DefaultCMYK replaces DeviceCMYK in an invoked image before device-colour validation.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: device_gray_image_no_output
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: An invoked DeviceGray image requires a PDF/A-1 output colour space.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: device_gray_image_default
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: DefaultGray replaces DeviceGray in an invoked image, so no uncalibrated colour-space object is exposed even without an output intent.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: intent_annotation_appearance
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: A non-standard ri operand in an annotation appearance is validated.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: intent_annotation_valid
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: A standard rendering intent in an annotation appearance is accepted.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: intent_annotation_state
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: Every normal Widget appearance state is traversed for rendering intents, not only the state selected by AS.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: intent_annotation_down
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: A down appearance is traversed for rendering intent even though the D entry independently violates the annotation AP predicate.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: intent_annotation_unreferenced
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: An invalid rendering intent in an appearance on an unreferenced annotation remains inapplicable.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: intent_pattern_content
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: A non-standard ri operand in painted Pattern content is validated.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: intent_pattern_valid
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: A standard rendering intent in painted Pattern content is accepted.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: intent_pattern_unused
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: An unpainted Pattern resource does not expose the invalid rendering intent in its content.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: intent_inline_image
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: A non-standard Intent name in an executed inline image is validated.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: intent_inline_valid
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: A standard Intent name in an executed inline image is accepted.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: intent_inline_wrong_type
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: A non-name inline-image Intent creates no CosRenderingIntent model object.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: intent_alternate_image
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: An invoked image traverses an alternate image and validates its Intent independently of the Alternates prohibition.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: icc_soft_mask_group
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: veraPDF rejects the used SMask but does not expose an ICCBased colour space or PDGroup from its G Form.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: device_soft_mask_group
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: veraPDF rejects the used SMask but does not expose DeviceRGB use or a PDGroup from its G Form.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: intent_soft_mask_group
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: veraPDF rejects the used SMask but does not expose rendering-intent or PDGroup model objects from its G Form.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: icc_shading_pattern_direct
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: A selected direct shading Pattern exposes its Shading ColorSpace.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: icc_shading_pattern_indirect
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: A selected indirect shading Pattern exposes its Shading ColorSpace.

atomic_color_path_cases.name: icc_shading_pattern_unused
atomic_color_path_cases.rationale: An unselected shading Pattern does not expose its Shading ColorSpace.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_identity_v
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: Identity-V is exempt from CIDSystemInfo compatibility and CMap embedding, while the CIDToGIDMap is Identity.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_indirect_identity_h
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: An indirect reference to the name /Identity-H is accepted exactly like a direct one, exempt from CIDSystemInfo compatibility and CMap embedding just like composite_identity_v.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_cidmap_missing
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: A visible Type 2 CIDFont descendant has no CIDToGIDMap.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_cidmap_missing_indirect_subtype
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: The descendant's own /Subtype as an indirect reference to /CIDFontType2 is resolved and recognized exactly like a direct name, so a missing /CIDToGIDMap is still caught rather than the descendant being treated as an unrecognized subtype and the check silently skipped.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_cidmap_invalid_name
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: A visible Type 2 CIDFont descendant uses a CIDToGIDMap name other than Identity.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_cidmap_stream
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: An embedded stream is a valid modeled CIDToGIDMap.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_cidmap_indirect_identity
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: An indirect reference to the name /Identity is accepted exactly like a direct one.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_named_cmap
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: A non-Identity named CMap is not embedded and its Adobe/Japan1 system information conflicts with the Adobe/Identity CIDFont.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_named_cmap_cidset_real_program
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: The exact predefined UniJIS-UCS2-H CMap bundled by veraPDF maps rendered code 003F to CID 32, so the matching Adobe/Japan1 system info passes while the unembedded-CMap and missing-CIDSet predicates both fail.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_cmap_cid_too_large
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: An embedded CMap maps codes to CIDs above the PDF/A-1 maximum of 65,535.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_cmap_matching
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: An embedded CMap has matching CIDSystemInfo and matching default WMode values.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_indirect_cid_system_info
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: The descendant's CIDSystemInfo /Registry is an indirect reference to a matching string, resolved and compared exactly like a direct value.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_cmap_mismatch_system
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: The embedded CMap's Ordering differs from its CIDFont descendant's Ordering.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_cmap_wmode_match
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: The embedded CMap stream and dictionary both declare WMode 1.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_cmap_wmode_mismatch
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: The embedded CMap stream declares WMode 0 while its dictionary declares WMode 1.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_cmap_wmode_indirect_match
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: The dictionary /WMode is an indirect reference to 1, matching the embedded CMap stream's own WMode 1 declaration; resolved and compared exactly like a direct value.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_cid_subset_missing_cidset
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: A subset CIDFont descriptor omits CIDSet for a rendered CID.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_cidset_real_program
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: A subset CIDFont CIDSet omits a rendered CID present in a real bounded font program.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_cidset_indirect_basefont_real_program
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: The descendant's own /BaseFont as an indirect reference to a subset-tagged name is resolved and recognized exactly like a direct name, so a CIDSet omitting a rendered CID is still caught rather than the descendant being treated as non-subset and silently skipped.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_identity_width_mismatch
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: An Identity-H rendered CID width differs from the embedded TrueType width.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_descendant_subtype_indirect_width_mismatch
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: The descendant's own /Subtype as an indirect reference to the name /CIDFontType2 is resolved and recognized exactly like a direct name, so a genuine /DW mismatch is still caught rather than the descendant being treated as an unrecognized subtype and silently skipped.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_dw_indirect_mismatch
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: /DW as an indirect reference to a mismatched value is resolved and compared exactly like a direct value.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_w_singles_element_indirect_mismatch
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: A /W singles group whose one width entry is an indirect reference to a mismatched value is resolved and compared exactly like a direct value.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_cff_cidset_missing
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: A subset CIDFontType0C CIDSet omits the rendered CID.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_cff_present_glyph
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: A subset CIDFontType0C has both a rendered glyph and a CIDSet bit for its CID.

atomic_device_color_cases.name: rgb_operator
atomic_device_color_cases.rationale: The rg and RG operators use DeviceRGB, which matches the RGB PDF/A-1 output intent.

atomic_device_color_cases.name: cmyk_operator
atomic_device_color_cases.rationale: The k and K operators use DeviceCMYK while the PDF/A-1 output intent is RGB.

atomic_device_color_cases.name: gray_operator
atomic_device_color_cases.rationale: DeviceGray requires an applicable PDF/A-1 output intent but does not require a matching data colour space.

atomic_device_color_cases.name: rgb_with_cmyk_output
atomic_device_color_cases.rationale: DeviceRGB does not match a CMYK PDF/A-1 output intent.

atomic_device_color_cases.name: cmyk_with_cmyk_output
atomic_device_color_cases.rationale: DeviceCMYK matches the CMYK PDF/A-1 output intent.

atomic_device_color_cases.name: gray_with_cmyk_output
atomic_device_color_cases.rationale: A CMYK PDF/A-1 output intent is sufficient for DeviceGray.

atomic_device_color_cases.name: rgb_without_output
atomic_device_color_cases.rationale: DeviceRGB is used without an output intent.

atomic_device_color_cases.name: cmyk_without_output
atomic_device_color_cases.rationale: DeviceCMYK is used without an output intent.

atomic_device_color_cases.name: gray_without_output
atomic_device_color_cases.rationale: DeviceGray is used without an output intent.

atomic_device_color_cases.name: rgb_wrong_s
atomic_device_color_cases.rationale: An RGB destination profile whose output-intent subtype is not GTS_PDFA1 does not define the global PDF/A-1 output colour space.

atomic_device_color_cases.name: explicit_rgb
atomic_device_color_cases.rationale: Direct CS and cs selections of DeviceRGB instantiate the rule and conflict with the CMYK output intent.

atomic_device_color_cases.name: resource_rgb
atomic_device_color_cases.rationale: A selected named resource resolving to DeviceRGB instantiates the rule and conflicts with the CMYK output intent.

atomic_device_color_cases.name: unused_resource_rgb
atomic_device_color_cases.rationale: An unselected DeviceRGB resource remains inapplicable even with a conflicting CMYK output intent.

atomic_device_color_cases.name: default_rgb_override
atomic_device_color_cases.rationale: A valid ICCBased DefaultRGB override prevents rg and RG from instantiating DeviceRGB even with a conflicting CMYK output intent.

atomic_device_color_cases.name: form_rgb
atomic_device_color_cases.rationale: DeviceRGB operators in an invoked Form participate and conflict with the CMYK output intent.

atomic_device_color_cases.name: image_rgb
atomic_device_color_cases.rationale: An invoked image with DeviceRGB ColorSpace participates and conflicts with the CMYK output intent.

atomic_device_color_cases.name: inline_rgb
atomic_device_color_cases.rationale: The RGB abbreviation in an inline image selects DeviceRGB and conflicts with the CMYK output intent.

atomic_device_color_cases.name: shading_rgb
atomic_device_color_cases.rationale: A used shading with DeviceRGB ColorSpace participates and conflicts with the CMYK output intent.

atomic_device_color_cases.name: indexed_rgb
atomic_device_color_cases.rationale: The DeviceRGB base of a selected Indexed colour space participates and conflicts with the CMYK output intent.

atomic_device_color_cases.name: separation_rgb
atomic_device_color_cases.rationale: The DeviceRGB alternate of a selected Separation colour space participates and conflicts with the CMYK output intent.

atomic_device_color_cases.name: devicen_rgb
atomic_device_color_cases.rationale: The DeviceRGB alternate of a selected DeviceN colour space participates and conflicts with the CMYK output intent.

atomic_device_color_cases.name: pattern_rgb
atomic_device_color_cases.rationale: veraPDF 1.30.2 does not expose a PDDeviceRGB object from the underlying space of a painted uncoloured Pattern.

atomic_device_color_cases.name: devicen_nine_components
atomic_device_color_cases.rationale: An executed DeviceN colour space has nine components and an RGB alternate without a matching output intent.

atomic_device_color_cases.name: rgb_wrong_arity_with_cmyk_output
atomic_device_color_cases.rationale: veraPDF still exposes DeviceRGB use from an rg operator with too few operands.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: baseline
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: A catalog with neither an EmbeddedFiles name-tree entry nor OCProperties passes both document-level prohibitions.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: names_empty
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: An empty Names dictionary has no EmbeddedFiles entry.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: names_embedded_files_dictionary
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: A dictionary-based Names value containing EmbeddedFiles fails the name-tree prohibition.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: names_embedded_files_wrong_type
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: The pinned CosDocument predicate tests EmbeddedFiles key presence without validating its value type.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: names_embedded_files_null
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: A direct null value is normalized as an absent dictionary entry by the pinned COS model.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: names_embedded_files_indirect_null
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: An indirect value keeps the EmbeddedFiles key present even when its target is null.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: names_stream_embedded_files
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: Names must resolve specifically to a dictionary; a stream does not instantiate the predicate.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: names_wrong_type
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: A scalar Names value is not a dictionary-based name tree.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: names_indirect_dictionary
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: An indirect dictionary Names value is resolved before checking EmbeddedFiles.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: unreferenced_names_embedded_files
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: An unreferenced name-tree-looking object is outside the catalog model.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: file_spec_without_ef
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: A file specification in the EmbeddedFiles name tree without EF passes the file-specification predicate.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: file_spec_with_ef
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: A direct file specification with EF is reached from the EmbeddedFiles name tree and fails both prohibitions.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: file_spec_direct_null_ef
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: A file specification's direct null EF value is empty and passes the file-specification predicate, matching the same direct-null convention as the enclosing EmbeddedFiles key.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: file_spec_indirect_null_ef
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: An indirect null EF value remains a present key and fails, matching the same indirect-null convention as the enclosing EmbeddedFiles key.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: file_spec_indirect_with_ef
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: An indirect file specification is dereferenced by the name-tree model and its EF key is forbidden.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: file_spec_stream_with_ef
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: The pinned dictionary-based test also models a stream-valued name-tree file specification.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: file_spec_scalar
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: A scalar name-tree value does not instantiate CosFileSpecification.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: embedded_files_kids_with_ef
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: File specifications in child name-tree nodes are recursively reached.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: stream_f
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: A stream dictionary's F entry is forbidden even when the stream is otherwise unreferenced.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: stream_ffilter
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: A stream dictionary's FFilter entry is forbidden regardless of value type.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: stream_fdecodeparms
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: A stream dictionary's FDecodeParms entry is forbidden regardless of value type.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: stream_external_null
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: A direct null stream entry is empty in the pinned COS model.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: stream_lzwdecode
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: A direct LZWDecode stream filter is forbidden.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: stream_lzwdecode_array
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: Every filter in a stream Filter array participates in the pinned predicate.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: stream_lzwdecode_indirect
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: An indirectly stored LZWDecode name is resolved by the stream filter model.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: stream_lzw_short_name
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: The ordinary stream rule tests only LZWDecode, not the inline-image LZW alias.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: ocproperties_dictionary
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: Any non-empty OCProperties catalog entry instantiates the optional-content prohibition.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: ocproperties_wrong_type
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: The pinned presence test does not require OCProperties to be a dictionary.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: ocproperties_null
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: A direct null catalog entry is empty in the pinned COS model.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: ocproperties_indirect_null
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: An indirect null remains a non-empty catalog reference for the pinned presence test.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: ocproperties_stream
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: A stream-valued OCProperties entry is still present.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: unreferenced_catalog_ocproperties
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: An unreferenced catalog-like dictionary does not affect the document catalog model.

atomic_font_cases.name: unembedded_visible
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A visible TrueType font has no embedded font program.

atomic_font_cases.name: font_subtype_indirect_unembedded
atomic_font_cases.rationale: /Subtype as an indirect reference to the name /TrueType is resolved and recognized exactly like a direct name, so an otherwise-unembedded font is still checked rather than treated as an unsupported/inapplicable subtype.

atomic_font_cases.name: type1_fontfile_header_only_garbage
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A /FontFile stream starting with the Type1 magic header but containing no eexec-encrypted section at all is not considered embedded by veraPDF; the magic-byte-only heuristic is a confirmed false negative without also requiring an eexec marker.

atomic_font_cases.name: type1c_header_only_garbage
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A /FontFile3 stream matching only the CFF header-byte shape but containing no parseable CFF structure is not considered embedded by veraPDF; the header-byte-only heuristic is a confirmed false negative without full CFF table parseability.

atomic_font_cases.name: type1c_embedded_indirect_subtype
atomic_font_cases.rationale: An embedded FontFile3 stream's own /Subtype as an indirect reference to /Type1C is resolved and recognized exactly like a direct name, so a validly embedded Type1C program still counts as embedded.

atomic_font_cases.name: mixed_rendering_modes
atomic_font_cases.rationale: veraPDF 1.30.2 retains rendering mode 3 from the font's first text-show use.

atomic_font_cases.name: mixed_visible_first
atomic_font_cases.rationale: veraPDF 1.30.2 retains visible mode 0 from the font's first text-show use.

atomic_font_cases.name: direct_font
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A directly embedded Font resource dictionary still instantiates the rule.

atomic_font_cases.name: form_unembedded
atomic_font_cases.rationale: Visible text in a Form XObject uses an unembedded font.

atomic_font_cases.name: form_unembedded_indirect_subtype
atomic_font_cases.rationale: The Form XObject's own /Subtype as an indirect reference to the name /Form is resolved and recognized exactly like a direct name, so a font used only inside it is still discovered and checked rather than the whole form being invisible to font discovery.

atomic_font_cases.name: inherited_resources
atomic_font_cases.rationale: The page inherits its unembedded font resource from the Pages node.

atomic_font_cases.name: type0_unembedded_descendant
atomic_font_cases.rationale: Type0 is exempt directly, but its used unembedded CIDFont descendant is not.

atomic_font_cases.name: type0_embedded_descendant
atomic_font_cases.rationale: The CIDFont descendant is embedded; the synthetic font's unrelated glyph failure is recorded explicitly.

atomic_font_cases.name: type3_visible
atomic_font_cases.rationale: Type3 is exempt from the embedding rule; incomplete synthetic glyph data triggers unrelated rules.

atomic_font_cases.name: type3_width_match
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A rendered Type3 /space CharProc starts with `500 0 d0`, matching its dictionary width.

atomic_font_cases.name: type3_width_mismatch
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A present rendered Type3 glyph declares width 400 with d0 while /Widths declares 500.

atomic_font_cases.name: type3_width_d1_mismatch
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A present rendered Type3 glyph declares width 400 with d1 while /Widths declares 500.

atomic_font_cases.name: type3_width_tolerance_boundary
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A Type3 CharProc width of 499 and dictionary width of 500 are exactly one unit apart, the inclusive veraPDF tolerance boundary.

atomic_font_cases.name: type3_missing_charproc_zero_width
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A missing Type3 CharProc has veraPDF program width zero; with /Widths also zero, only glyph presence fails and the metric predicate passes.

atomic_font_cases.name: type3_macroman_base
atomic_font_cases.rationale: MacRomanEncoding maps rendered byte 202 to /space, selecting the matching Type3 CharProc and width; this byte distinguishes the pinned MacRoman table from StandardEncoding.

atomic_font_cases.name: type3_macexpert_base
atomic_font_cases.rationale: MacExpertEncoding maps rendered byte 33 to /exclamsmall, selecting the matching Type3 CharProc and width.

atomic_font_cases.name: direct_descriptor
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A direct descriptor resolving to an indirect valid font program is accepted.

atomic_font_cases.name: direct_font_file
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A direct descriptor and direct valid font-file stream are accepted.

atomic_font_cases.name: malformed_font_program
atomic_font_cases.rationale: veraPDF does not expose containsFontFile for a stream whose bytes are not a recognized font program.

atomic_font_cases.name: graphics_state_visible
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A visible text-show inside q/Q records visible rendering mode.

atomic_font_cases.name: cyclic_form
atomic_font_cases.rationale: The used font is checked once while cyclic Form recursion is bounded.

atomic_font_cases.name: font_type_missing
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A used Font dictionary has no required Type entry.

atomic_font_cases.name: font_type_invalid
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A used Font dictionary has a Type name other than Font.

atomic_font_cases.name: font_subtype_missing
atomic_font_cases.rationale: veraPDF creates no PDFont model object when the Subtype entry is missing, so the predicate is inapplicable.

atomic_font_cases.name: font_subtype_invalid
atomic_font_cases.rationale: veraPDF creates no PDFont model object for an unsupported Subtype name, so the predicate is inapplicable.

atomic_font_cases.name: font_basefont_missing
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A used non-Type3 Font dictionary has no BaseFont name.

atomic_font_cases.name: font_basefont_invalid
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A used non-Type3 Font dictionary has a non-name BaseFont value.

atomic_font_cases.name: font_firstchar_missing
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A used non-standard simple font has no FirstChar; its Widths-size expression consequently also fails.

atomic_font_cases.name: font_lastchar_missing
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A used non-standard simple font has no LastChar; its Widths-size expression consequently also fails.

atomic_font_cases.name: font_widths_missing
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A used non-standard simple font has no Widths array.

atomic_font_cases.name: font_widths_wrong_size
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A used non-standard simple font's Widths array length differs from LastChar minus FirstChar plus one.

atomic_font_cases.name: font_firstchar_lastchar_indirect
atomic_font_cases.rationale: /FirstChar and /LastChar as indirect references to matching integers are resolved and compared exactly like direct values.

atomic_font_cases.name: font_widths_array_indirect
atomic_font_cases.rationale: The whole /Widths array as an indirect reference to a correctly sized, matching-value array is resolved and compared exactly like a direct array.

atomic_font_cases.name: font_widths_element_indirect_mismatch
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A direct /Widths array whose single entry is an indirect reference to a mismatched value is resolved and compared exactly like a direct value.

atomic_font_cases.name: standard14_missing_metrics
atomic_font_cases.rationale: The standard Helvetica font is exempt from FirstChar, LastChar, and Widths.

atomic_font_cases.name: truetype_named_standard14_missing_metrics
atomic_font_cases.rationale: The standard-14-fonts FirstChar/LastChar/Widths exemption is scoped to Type1/MMType1 only: a TrueType font named Helvetica is not exempt, unlike standard14_missing_metrics above.

atomic_font_cases.name: font_file_subtype_invalid
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A used font's embedded font stream declares a Subtype other than Type1C or CIDFontType0C.

atomic_font_cases.name: type1c_glyph_missing
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A rendered Type1C byte has no glyph in the embedded CFF program.

atomic_font_cases.name: type1c_glyph_present
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A rendered Type1C byte resolves to a glyph in the embedded CFF program.

atomic_font_cases.name: type1c_width_mismatch
atomic_font_cases.rationale: The embedded Type1C glyph width differs from the dictionary width by more than one unit.

atomic_font_cases.name: type1c_subset_complete
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A subset Type1C font's PDF encoding maps the rendered byte to /space, and /CharSet lists that embedded glyph.

atomic_font_cases.name: type1c_subset_incomplete
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A subset Type1C font's PDF encoding maps the rendered byte to /space, but /CharSet omits that embedded glyph.

atomic_font_cases.name: type1c_subset_program_encoding_ignored
atomic_font_cases.rationale: veraPDF uses the PDF encoding name, not the Type1C program's fallback encoding, for the subset /CharSet membership predicate; with no PDF /Encoding, the omitted /space name is inapplicable.

atomic_font_cases.name: type1_real_symbol_present
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A real embedded Type1 program maps rendered byte 34 through its own encoding to /universal, which is present with the matching 713-unit width.

atomic_font_cases.name: type1_real_symbol_difference_present
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A PDF /Differences entry maps rendered byte 34 to the real Type1 program's /universal glyph and matching width.

atomic_font_cases.name: type1_real_symbol_pdf_base_missing_glyph
atomic_font_cases.rationale: WinAnsiEncoding overrides the Type1 program encoding and maps byte 34 to absent /quotedbl; veraPDF reports both glyph absence and program width zero versus /Widths 713.

atomic_font_cases.name: type1_real_symbol_width_mismatch
atomic_font_cases.rationale: The real Type1 program's /universal glyph width is 713 while the PDF /Widths entry is 700.

atomic_font_cases.name: type1_real_symbol_subset_complete
atomic_font_cases.rationale: The subset Type1 font's PDF /Differences mapping selects /universal, and /CharSet lists it.

atomic_font_cases.name: type1_real_symbol_subset_incomplete
atomic_font_cases.rationale: The subset Type1 font's PDF /Differences mapping selects /universal, but /CharSet omits it.

atomic_font_cases.name: type1_real_symbol_subset_program_encoding_ignored
atomic_font_cases.rationale: veraPDF uses the PDF encoding name, not the Type1 program's own encoding fallback, for subset /CharSet membership; with no PDF /Encoding, the omitted /universal name is inapplicable.

atomic_font_content_source_cases.name: annotation_appearance_unembedded
atomic_font_content_source_cases.rationale: A font used only from a FreeText annotation's /AP /N appearance stream, never from the page's own content, still populates a PDFont object in veraPDF 1.30.2 and is still checked for embedding.

atomic_font_content_source_cases.name: widget_state_unembedded
atomic_font_content_source_cases.rationale: veraPDF 1.30.2 walks every state stream in a button Widget's /AP /N subdictionary, not only the one named by /AS, so a font used only in a non-selected state is still checked for embedding.

atomic_font_content_source_cases.name: down_appearance_unembedded
atomic_font_content_source_cases.rationale: veraPDF 1.30.2 walks a /D (down) appearance stream for font use just like /N, even though /D's mere presence already independently fails PDFA1B-ANNOTATION-AP-ENTRIES-001 (an /AP dictionary with entries other than only /N).

atomic_font_content_source_cases.name: pattern_unembedded
atomic_font_content_source_cases.rationale: A font used only inside a tiling Pattern's own content stream, selected via cs/scn and actually painted, still populates a PDFont object in veraPDF 1.30.2.

atomic_font_content_source_cases.name: pattern_unused
atomic_font_content_source_cases.rationale: A Pattern resource that is declared but never selected via cs/scn is not used, so its font must not be flagged, in veraPDF 1.30.2 or locally.

atomic_font_content_source_cases.name: type3_charproc_unembedded
atomic_font_content_source_cases.rationale: A font used only inside a Type3 font's own rendered glyph /CharProcs stream still populates a PDFont object in veraPDF 1.30.2; the Type3 font itself is exempt from this rule but the nested font is not.

atomic_form_cases.name: baseline
atomic_form_cases.rationale: An AcroForm with NeedAppearances false and a page Widget with an AP dictionary satisfy both pinned predicates.

atomic_form_cases.name: no_acroform
atomic_form_cases.rationale: Without a catalog AcroForm, the NeedAppearances predicate is inapplicable.

atomic_form_cases.name: need_appearances_absent
atomic_form_cases.rationale: An absent NeedAppearances key is exposed as null and passes.

atomic_form_cases.name: need_appearances_false_indirect
atomic_form_cases.rationale: An indirectly stored false boolean passes.

atomic_form_cases.name: need_appearances_true
atomic_form_cases.rationale: NeedAppearances true is forbidden.

atomic_form_cases.name: need_appearances_true_indirect
atomic_form_cases.rationale: An indirectly stored true boolean remains forbidden.

atomic_form_cases.name: need_appearances_wrong_type
atomic_form_cases.rationale: veraPDF exposes a present non-boolean NeedAppearances value as true.

atomic_form_cases.name: need_appearances_null
atomic_form_cases.rationale: An explicit null is treated as an empty value and passes.

atomic_form_cases.name: acroform_wrong_type
atomic_form_cases.rationale: A non-dictionary-based AcroForm value creates no PDAcroForm model object.

atomic_form_cases.name: acroform_stream_true
atomic_form_cases.rationale: A stream is dictionary-based in the pinned catalog model, so its true NeedAppearances value is evaluated.

atomic_form_cases.name: widget_missing_ap
atomic_form_cases.rationale: A page Widget without AP fails the appearance-presence predicate.

atomic_form_cases.name: widget_indirect_subtype_missing_ap
atomic_form_cases.rationale: An indirect Widget Subtype is resolved during page annotation creation, so missing AP still fails.

atomic_form_cases.name: stream_widget_missing_ap
atomic_form_cases.rationale: A stream-backed Widget in page Annots does not instantiate PDWidgetAnnot and is inapplicable to the AP predicate.

atomic_form_cases.name: widget_empty_ap
atomic_form_cases.rationale: An empty AP dictionary exists for §6.9 test 2 but separately fails the allowed-entry predicate.

atomic_form_cases.name: widget_wrong_type_ap
atomic_form_cases.rationale: A scalar AP value is exposed as null.

atomic_form_cases.name: widget_stream_ap
atomic_form_cases.rationale: AP must resolve specifically to a dictionary; a stream is exposed as null.

atomic_form_cases.name: widget_indirect_ap
atomic_form_cases.rationale: An indirect AP dictionary is resolved and passes.

atomic_form_cases.name: non_widget_missing_ap
atomic_form_cases.rationale: The §6.9 appearance-presence rule is instantiated only for Widget annotations.

atomic_form_cases.name: field_only_widget_missing_ap
atomic_form_cases.rationale: A Widget-looking AcroForm field not reached from page Annots does not instantiate PDWidgetAnnot.

atomic_form_cases.name: direct_widget_missing_ap
atomic_form_cases.rationale: A direct Widget dictionary in page Annots is evaluated.

atomic_form_cases.name: widget_parent_ap_only
atomic_form_cases.rationale: AP is not inherited from a Widget parent.

atomic_form_cases.name: unreferenced_widget_missing_ap
atomic_form_cases.rationale: An unreferenced Widget-looking dictionary is outside the page annotation model.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: direct_extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A direct ExtGState selected by gs contains a forbidden TR entry.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A used ExtGState dictionary contains the forbidden TR entry.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: extgstate_tr_null
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A used ExtGState dictionary's direct null TR value is empty and passes containsTR, matching the same direct-null convention confirmed for containsAA.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: extgstate_tr2_default
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: TR2 is permitted when its value is the name Default.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: extgstate_tr2_null
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A used ExtGState dictionary's direct null TR2 value is empty and passes containsTR2.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: extgstate_tr2_other
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A used ExtGState dictionary has a TR2 value other than Default.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: unused_extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An ExtGState resource is inapplicable until selected by the gs operator.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: unreferenced_extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An unreferenced ExtGState dictionary is outside veraPDF's modeled graphics-state graph.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: ri_standard
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: All four standard rendering-intent names are accepted by the ri operator.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: ri_invalid
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: The ri operator selects a non-standard rendering-intent name.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: extgstate_ri_invalid
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A used ExtGState dictionary contains a non-standard RI name.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: image_intent_valid
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An invoked image uses the standard Perceptual Intent.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: image_intent_invalid
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An invoked image contains a non-standard Intent name.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: explicit_mask_image_intent_invalid
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An Image reached only through another Image's Mask entry does not expose its Intent as a rendering-intent model object in veraPDF 1.30.2.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: soft_mask_image_intent_invalid
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An Image reached through SMask still exposes its non-standard Intent, while the primary Image's forbidden SMask entry independently remains applicable.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: undefined_operator
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: Page content contains an operator not defined by PDF 1.4.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: undefined_in_bx
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: PDF/A-1 rejects an undefined operator even inside BX and EX compatibility sections.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: known_operators
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: Standard PDF 1.4 graphics operators remain accepted.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: graphics_state_nesting_28
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: The PDF/A-1 graphics-state nesting limit is inclusive at 28 q operators.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: graphics_state_nesting_29
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: The 29th nested q operator exceeds the PDF/A-1 graphics-state limit.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: undefined_form
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: Content in an invoked Form contains an undefined operator.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: unused_form_undefined
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: Content in an uninvoked Form is outside veraPDF's modeled content graph.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: undefined_appearance
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An undefined operator in a referenced annotation appearance is executed by veraPDF.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: unused_appearance_undefined
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An appearance belonging only to an unreferenced annotation is outside the modeled content graph.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: undefined_pattern
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An undefined operator in a selected tiling Pattern is executed by veraPDF.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: unused_pattern_undefined
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A declared but unselected tiling Pattern is outside the modeled content graph.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: undefined_type3
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An undefined operator in the rendered glyph CharProc of a used Type3 font is executed by veraPDF.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: unused_type3_undefined
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A Type3 CharProc is inapplicable until its font and glyph are rendered.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: undefined_soft_mask_group
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: veraPDF rejects the selected ExtGState SMask but does not expose the SMask/G Form's operators or Group as validation-model objects.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: unused_soft_mask_group_undefined
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An unselected ExtGState and its SMask/G Form remain entirely outside veraPDF's modeled graph.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: inline_image_lzw
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An executed inline image declares the forbidden LZWDecode filter.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: inline_image_lzw_array
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An executed inline image includes LZWDecode in a filter array.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: inline_image_lzw_escaped
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: PDF name hex escapes are decoded before matching the inline-image LZWDecode filter.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: inline_image_ascii_hex
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An executed inline image uses ASCIIHexDecode rather than LZW.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: inline_image_false_ei
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: The letters EI embedded without PDF token boundaries in inline-image data do not terminate the image.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: inline_image_tokens_in_string
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: BI, ID, EI, and LZW-looking text inside a literal string is not executable inline-image syntax.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: indirect_extgstate_resource_dictionary
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: The ExtGState resource-category dictionary is indirect and resolves before gs selects its entry.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: inherited_extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A page inherits and selects its ExtGState from the page tree.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: extgstate_tr_indirect_null
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An indirect reference to null remains a meaningfully present TR entry in veraPDF 1.30.2.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: undefined_before_malformed_array
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: veraPDF discards the content operation population when the stream ends inside an unterminated array.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: malformed_string_before_undefined
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: veraPDF creates no undefined-operator model when an unterminated literal string consumes the remaining bytes.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: gs_wrong_operand
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A gs operation with a non-name operand does not select an ExtGState resource.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: gs_extra_operand
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A gs operation with extra operands does not select an ExtGState resource.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: inline_image_unterminated_lzw
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An unterminated inline image still exposes its LZW filter to veraPDF.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: shading_pattern_extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: veraPDF models a selected shading Pattern and its Shading but does not expose the Pattern ExtGState entry as a PDExtGState.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: direct_shading_pattern_extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: The omission of a shading Pattern ExtGState also applies when the Pattern dictionary is direct.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_form_undefined
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An invoked Form executes its undefined operators.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_form_extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An invoked Form resolves and validates an ExtGState from its own resources.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_form_image_bpc_16
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An Image invoked only from a Form enters the XObject population.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_form_nesting_29
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: Graphics-state nesting is counted inside an invoked Form.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_form_inline_lzw
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An inline image in an invoked Form enters the inline-image model.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_form_invalid_intent
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A rendering intent selected inside an invoked Form is validated.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_form_fallback_extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A Form resolves a missing ExtGState category through the containing page resources.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_form_missing_resources_fallback_extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A Form with no Resources entry resolves an ExtGState through its page resources.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_form_parent_only_extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A nested Form with no matching resource does not inherit an ExtGState that exists only in its invoking Form; veraPDF's fallback context is the page resources.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_form_missing_resources_parent_extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A nested Form with no Resources entry still falls back to the page, not to an ExtGState that exists only in its invoking Form.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_appearance_undefined
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An annotation appearance executes its undefined operators.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_appearance_missing_subtype_undefined
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An annotation appearance stream without an explicit Form subtype is still reached through veraPDF 1.30.2's annotation appearance model.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_appearance_missing_subtype_form_ref
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An annotation appearance stream without an explicit Form subtype is still modeled as a Form XObject, including its forbidden Ref entry.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_appearance_image_subtype_bpc_16
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A stream reached only as an annotation appearance remains a Form-role object in veraPDF 1.30.2 even when its malformed dictionary declares Subtype Image.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_appearance_appearance_and_painted_image_bpc_16
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: The same malformed stream is both an annotation appearance Form and an Image invoked by Do; veraPDF retains both roles and applies the Image BitsPerComponent predicate only because of the ordinary invocation.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_appearance_nested_state_undefined
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: veraPDF reports the malformed normal appearance but stops after the one permitted state-dictionary layer, so it does not reach a stream nested inside another dictionary.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_appearance_extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An annotation appearance resolves and validates an ExtGState from its own resources.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_appearance_nesting_29
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: Graphics-state nesting is counted inside an annotation appearance.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_appearance_inline_lzw
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An inline image in an annotation appearance enters the inline-image model.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_appearance_invalid_intent
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A rendering intent selected inside an annotation appearance is validated.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_appearance_fallback_extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An annotation appearance resolves a missing ExtGState category through its page resources.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_appearance_missing_resources_fallback_extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An annotation appearance with no Resources entry resolves an ExtGState through its page resources.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_pattern_undefined
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A selected tiling Pattern executes its undefined operators.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_pattern_extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A selected tiling Pattern resolves and validates an ExtGState from its own resources.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_pattern_image_bpc_16
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An Image invoked only from a selected tiling Pattern enters the XObject population.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_pattern_inline_lzw
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An inline image in a selected tiling Pattern enters the inline-image model.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_pattern_invalid_intent
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A rendering intent selected inside a tiling Pattern is validated.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_pattern_fallback_extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A tiling Pattern resolves a missing ExtGState category through the containing page resources.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_pattern_missing_resources_fallback_extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A tiling Pattern with no Resources entry resolves an ExtGState through its page resources.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_pattern_missing_resources_parent_extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A selected tiling Pattern with no Resources entry does not inherit the invoking Form context; unresolved names fall back only to page resources.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_pattern_empty_resources_parent_extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An explicit empty Resources dictionary on a tiling Pattern resets the invoking Form context; unresolved names then fall back only to page resources.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_type3_undefined
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A rendered Type3 glyph CharProc executes its undefined operators.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_type3_extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A rendered Type3 glyph CharProc resolves and validates an ExtGState from its font resources.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_type3_image_bpc_16
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An Image invoked only from a rendered Type3 glyph CharProc enters the XObject population.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_type3_nesting_29
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: Graphics-state nesting is counted inside a rendered Type3 glyph CharProc.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_type3_invalid_intent
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A rendering intent selected inside a rendered Type3 glyph CharProc is validated.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_soft_mask_undefined
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: veraPDF rejects the selected SMask but does not expose its G Form's undefined operator or transparency Group.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_soft_mask_extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: veraPDF rejects the selected SMask but does not expose its G Form's ExtGState or transparency Group.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_soft_mask_image_bpc_16
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: veraPDF rejects the selected SMask but does not expose its G Form's invoked Image or transparency Group.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_soft_mask_nesting_29
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: veraPDF rejects the selected SMask but does not execute its G Form graphics-state stack or expose its transparency Group.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_soft_mask_inline_lzw
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: veraPDF rejects the selected SMask but does not expose its G Form's inline image or transparency Group.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_appearance_image_bpc_16
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An Image invoked only from an annotation appearance is in the veraPDF XObject population.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_pattern_nesting_29
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: Graphics-state nesting is counted inside a selected tiling Pattern.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_type3_inline_lzw
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An inline image in a rendered Type3 glyph CharProc enters the inline-image model.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_type3_invisible_undefined
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: veraPDF executes a rendered Type3 CharProc for content rules even when the outer text rendering mode is 3.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_type3_malformed_text_show_undefined
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: veraPDF still executes the Type3 CharProc selected by a Tj operation with extra operands.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_type3_inherited_pattern_undefined
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A rendered Type3 CharProc inherits the caller's selected Pattern color space and executes the named Pattern.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_type3_fallback_extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A Type3 CharProc resolves a missing ExtGState category through the containing page resources, matching veraPDF.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_type3_missing_resources_fallback_extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A Type3 font with no Resources entry resolves a CharProc ExtGState through its page resources.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_type3_missing_resources_parent_extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A Type3 font with no Resources entry does not inherit an ExtGState that exists only in its invoking Form; CharProc fallback is page-scoped.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_type3_empty_resources_parent_extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An explicit empty Type3 Resources dictionary likewise prevents an invoking Form-only ExtGState from entering the CharProc resource context.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: path_soft_mask_invalid_intent
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: veraPDF rejects the selected SMask but does not execute the soft-mask G Form invalid rendering intent.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: malformed_pattern_leading_name
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: Only the final name operand of scn selects a Pattern; an earlier name does not execute that resource.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: malformed_pattern_trailing_number
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A non-name final scn operand does not select the earlier named Pattern resource.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: malformed_pattern_colorspace
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A cs operator with extra operands does not select Pattern color space, so the following scn does not execute the Pattern.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: baseline
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: Selecting a valid indirect RGB ICCBased resource with N = 3 instantiates and satisfies both pinned ICC profile predicates.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: class_prtr
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: Printer is an accepted ICC input-profile device class.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: class_mntr
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: Monitor is an accepted ICC input-profile device class.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: class_scnr
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: Input-device is an accepted ICC input-profile device class.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: class_spac
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: Colour-space conversion is an accepted ICC input-profile device class.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: color_rgb
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: RGB is an accepted ICC input-profile data colour space.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: color_cmyk
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: CMYK is an accepted ICC input-profile data colour space.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: color_gray
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: GRAY is an accepted ICC input-profile data colour space.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: color_lab
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: Lab is an accepted ICC input-profile data colour space.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: version_2_15
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: The high version nibble is 15 and 2.15 remains below 3.0.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: invalid_class
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: A device-link profile class is outside the four classes accepted by the pinned predicate.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: invalid_color_space
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: XYZ is outside the four accepted data colour spaces; the generated stream also has no valid N for adjacent test 2.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: version_3
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: Version 3.0 is not below the pinned upper bound.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: truncated_profile
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: Nineteen bytes cannot expose the complete class and colour-space fields; the generated stream also lacks N for adjacent test 2.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: undecodable_profile
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: A selected ICCBased stream whose declared filter cannot be decoded fails the pinned predicate and leaves no readable profile colour space for adjacent test 2.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: missing_n
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: A valid RGB ICC profile stream without N fails the pinned component-count predicate.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: wrong_n
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: N = 4 does not match an RGB ICC profile, which requires three components.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: non_integer_n
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: A name-valued N entry is not a valid component count.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: unused_resource
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: An ICCBased entry merely present in a page resource dictionary creates no ICCInputProfile model object.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: default_gray
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: Both g and G select an invalid ICCBased DefaultGray override from page resources.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: default_rgb
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: Both rg and RG select an invalid ICCBased DefaultRGB override from page resources.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: default_cmyk
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: Both k and K select an invalid ICCBased DefaultCMYK override from page resources.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: unused_default
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: A default colour-space override is inapplicable until its corresponding device-colour operator executes.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: inherited_resources
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: A selected ICCBased space resolves through inherited page-tree resources.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: missing_profile
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: An ICCBased array without a second operand creates no ICCInputProfile object for test 1.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: wrong_profile_type
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: A non-stream ICCBased profile operand creates no ICCInputProfile object for test 1.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: form_used
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: Selecting an ICCBased resource in the content of an invoked Form XObject instantiates the pinned rule.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: form_unused_resource
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: Invoking a Form does not model ICCBased resources that its content never selects.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: form_unreferenced
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: An unreferenced Form and its ICCBased resources are outside the pinned model traversal.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: form_parent_fallback
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: An invoked Form with partial resources falls back to the containing page resources for its selected named colour space.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: nested_form_page_fallback
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: Nested invoked Forms retain page-resource fallback when their own resources do not define the selected colour space.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: nested_form_used
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: Invoked nested Form content is traversed until its selected ICCBased resource is modeled.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: cyclic_form
