atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: A selected profile is evaluated once while a self-referential Form traversal terminates deterministically.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: image_used
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: Invoking an image XObject models its ICCBased ColorSpace.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: image_unused_resource
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: An image merely present in XObject resources is not traversed for the pinned ICCInputProfile rule.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: image_unreferenced
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: An unreferenced image and its ICCBased ColorSpace are outside the pinned model traversal.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: image_mask_ignores_color_space
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: An invoked image mask ignores its own ColorSpace entry and inherits the current fill colour space.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: image_smask_used
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: The pinned image model does not expose an ICCInputProfile from a soft-mask image ColorSpace; the synthetic transparency still triggers its unrelated PDF/A-1 transparency prohibition.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: image_mask_image_used
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: The pinned image model does not expose an ICCInputProfile from an explicit mask image ColorSpace; the synthetic mask triggers its unrelated colour-space restriction.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: image_alternate_used
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: Invoking an image traverses its Alternates images and models their ICCBased ColorSpace values; the alternate also triggers its unrelated image colour-space rule.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: inline_image_used
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: An inline image whose CS names an ICCBased resource instantiates the pinned ICCInputProfile rule.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: shading_used
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: The sh operator models the ICCBased ColorSpace of its selected shading resource.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: indexed_base_used
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: Selecting an Indexed colour space recursively models its ICCBased base space.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: repeated_shared_valid
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: Two selected aliases sharing one valid indirect profile reuse the same modeled profile and pass.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: repeated_shared_invalid
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: Two selected aliases sharing one invalid indirect profile produce one deterministic local aggregate.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: two_invalid_profiles
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: Two distinct selected invalid profiles aggregate into one local failure; the XYZ profile also fails adjacent test 2.

atomic_icc_based_cases.name: direct_profile
atomic_icc_based_cases.rationale: A directly embedded stream is malformed in this position; veraPDF 1.30.2 creates no ICCInputProfile model object, and the local parser likewise leaves the predicate inapplicable.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: first_rdf_package
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: Only the first RDF package selected by the pinned XMP parser contributes properties.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: empty_xmpmeta_stops_search
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: The pinned root search stops at the first xmpmeta element even when that element contains no RDF package; a later sibling RDF package is not selected.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: ix_changes_ignored
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: A top-level resource-form property whose lexical QName is exactly iX:changes is discarded by the pinned XMP parser, including otherwise-invalid nested CDATA and undefined properties.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: rdf_cdata_literal
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: Java DOM exposes CDATA separately from text, so the pinned RDF parser rejects CDATA in an ordinary literal property and invalidates the whole package.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: rdf_comment_between_properties
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: The pinned RDF parser ignores XML comments between property elements, so both validators preserve the valid metadata model.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: localized_language_normalization
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: The XMP 2004 parser normalizes X_DEFAULT to x-DEFAULT; with no exact x-default item, getLocalizedText selects it as the sole generic x language item.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: rdf_nbsp_between_descriptions
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: U+00A0 is Unicode whitespace but not Java Character.isWhitespace, so it is an invalid non-element child between RDF node elements.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: deprecated_dc_namespace
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: The pinned parser maps the deprecated Dublin Core 1.1 namespace URI to the XMP 2004 DC namespace before property lookup, typing, and Info comparison.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: lang_alt_partial_language
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: The pinned Lang Alt validator accepts an Alt array when any item carries xml:lang, even if another item is unqualified.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: unknown_rdf_property
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: An RDF-namespace attribute that is not RDF syntax becomes an ordinary top-level XMP property and therefore requires an extension definition and matching declared type.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: mismatched_rdf_about
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: Conflicting non-empty rdf:about values across top-level descriptions invalidate the complete XMP package.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: rdf_resource_and_value
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: rdf:resource and rdf:value are mutually exclusive on an empty property element, so their combination invalidates the complete XMP package.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: duplicate_producer
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: Duplicate named properties across RDF descriptions invalidate the entire XMP package.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: predefined_structured_field
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: A predefined structured field is validated as part of its top-level property value, not as another top-level property.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: predefined_structured_attribute_fields
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: Compact attribute fields in a predefined structured value are equivalent to expanded field elements.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: info_empty_property_value
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: An empty-property element with rdf:value is equivalent to a compact description attribute.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: keywords_qualified_parse_type
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: A parseType Resource property with rdf:value and a qualifier normalizes to the same simple Keywords value.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: title_qualified_expanded
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: An expanded rdf:Description with rdf:value normalizes a qualified language alternative before value typing and Info comparison.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: keywords_default_element
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: A property element in the default PDF namespace is equivalent to the prefixed compact attribute form.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: reordered_top_level_properties
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: Reordering a compact Producer attribute as the final expanded property element does not change the XMP data model.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: xmp_latin1_recovery
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: The pinned default XMP parse options recover an isolated Windows-1252 byte after the initial UTF-8 parse fails.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: xmp_ascii_control_reference_recovery
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: After XML rejects a numeric reference to an ASCII control, the pinned recovery reader substitutes a space.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: xmp_del_reference_preserved
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: A DEL numeric reference is accepted by the initial XML parse, so veraPDF does not enter its control-repair retry.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: xmp_utf16le_without_bom
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: The alternating leading bytes identify UTF-16LE XMP even without a byte-order mark.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: xmp_utf32be_without_bom
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: The leading zero pattern identifies UTF-32BE XMP even without a byte-order mark.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: rdf_parse_type_literal
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: The XMP 2004 parser rejects rdf:parseType Literal and invalidates the whole package.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: no_rdf_package
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: Well-formed XML without an RDF root produces an empty, serialization-valid XMP model.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: missing_metadata
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: Catalog Metadata is absent.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: missing_type
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: Metadata stream has no Type.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: missing_subtype
atomic_metadata_cases.rationale: Metadata stream has no Subtype.

atomic_metadata_cases.name: metadata_filter
